question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH user_ages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) - CASE WHEN strftime('%m%d', CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS DATE)) < strftime('%m%d', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
  FROM mst_users
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'Others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_ages
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'Others'
  END
ORDER BY age_category
